statement: Withholding a whole criterion to protect a score also withholds the evidence it read that never depended on the degraded input. On a shallow clone B2 abstained whole, taking its checked-out-file evidence (CI workflow, pull-request template) out of the composite with the history ratio; the overall is a mean of category means, and with B2 gone process_trust was B3 alone, so a forty-commit fixture fell from 2.3 to 1.5 against its own full clone. Rules: when an input is degraded, withhold only the components that read it; measure the degraded result against the same subject's complete input, not only against the previous scorer; and check whether a calibrated status rule reads the withheld component, because the status then falls back to the score bands.
